contract.purpose: Copy MyGRACE skill body markdown into bundled runtime asset directories.
contract.scope: Build-time asset placement for dist/index.js and dist/cli/*.js relative file loading.

interfaces.interface-1: npm run build copies src/mygrace/skill-bodies to dist/skill-bodies
interfaces.interface-2: npm run build copies src/mygrace/skill-bodies to dist/cli/skill-bodies

invariants.invariant-1: Every canonical MyGRACE skill body exists beside the library bundle.
invariants.invariant-2: Every canonical MyGRACE skill body exists beside the CLI bundle.
invariants.invariant-3: Installed web chat can run `/mygrace:init` without ENOENT.

evidence.command-2: rtk npm test -- tests/bundle-smoke.test.ts tests/mygrace-skills.test.ts tests/dashboard-mygrace-server.test.ts
